facts.description: The bidder itself holds an Ontario electrical contractor licence. False if the electrical work is subcontracted or the licence is deferred until after award.
The licence number exactly as written in the proposal.
The proposal states that the bidder has current WSIB clearance.
The proposal states liability insurance of at least 5 million dollars.
Number of commercial installations of 100 kW or more that the proposal says were completed. Use the figure as stated and do not add separate figures together.
First year of the period the installation count covers, when the proposal gives one. 'Since 2021' gives 2021. Null when no start year is given.
Total price in Canadian dollars as stated, without symbols or separators.
Weeks from award to completion. Only when the proposal commits to a duration. If the schedule is left open or depends on a later assessment, use status ambiguous with a null value.
Length of the panel warranty in years.
Length of the workmanship warranty in years.
The proposal says the project lead or manager is named or already designated. False if the lead is to be assigned later.
The proposal describes a crew or gives a crew size.
A site safety plan is included or described.
Performance monitoring of the installed system is included. Progress reports during construction do not count.
